events.title: Tabs & Modern Blue Theme Returning
events.description: After many complaints regarding the new Hack Forums theme, Omniscient announced he will revert to the previous Modern Blue theme with tabs navigation over the next few weeks. He also stated he will no longer be working on making the site responsive or mobile compliant.

events.title: Omniscient Injured in Car Accident
events.description: On Wednesday, November 8, Omniscient was involved in a car accident that resulted in a totaled vehicle, a concussion, bruised ribs, and a sore neck. The accident has caused delays on his work while he meets with lawyers, doctors, and insurance agents.

events.title: Suggestions and Ideas Forum Reopened
events.description: Omniscient has reopened the Suggestions and Ideas forum, allowing members to share ideas to improve the site. It was originally closed on August 6, 2017.
